contamination_boundaries: no reuse of the five pilot pairs
cost_model_gate: if PRECISION_EXTENSION_PASS then successor classification may allow COST_MODEL_DESIGN_ALLOWED
failure_rule: CI half-width > threshold => PRECISION_EXTENSION_FAIL; no re-run, no N increase
objective: independently test the same 4-GiB precision condition with N=600 fresh counted pairs
pairing: paired B - A within each block, both pairs of the block
precision_threshold: 1% of the extension's median b_selected step time
statistic: median paired difference; 95% percentile bootstrap CI
success_rule: CI half-width <= threshold AND inherited conditions 1-5,7 still hold
